question: Which of the following countries has the highest male to female population ratio in the world in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Qatar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Qatar has the highest male to female population ratio in the world, with significantly more males than females.
 
• This skewed ratio is primarily due to the high number of male expatriates in the country, many of whom are laborers working in various sectors like construction.
 
• The influx of male workers is driven by Qatar's rapid economic development and infrastructural projects, especially those related to the FIFA World Cup 2022 preparations.
 
• The male to female ratio in Qatar is approximately 3.1:1, meaning there are around three males for every female in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Male to Female Population Ratio**

 
 
• This ratio indicates the number of males for every female in a population.
 
• A ratio of 1:1 indicates an equal number of males and females.
 
• Countries with large numbers of male labor migrants often have higher ratios of males to females.
 
 
 
• **Expatriates**
 
 
• Expatriates, or expats, are people who reside in a country other than their native country.
 
• In countries like Qatar, a significant portion of the workforce consists of expatriates.
 
• The majority of expatriates in Qatar are males who have migrated for work opportunities.
 
 
 
• **Labor Migration**
 
 
• Labor migration refers to the movement of people from one country to another for the purpose of employment.
 
• Countries with booming economies and large-scale infrastructure projects attract labor migrants.
 
• Labor migration contributes to the demographic imbalances in countries like Qatar.
 
 
 
• **FIFA World Cup 2022**
 
 
• Qatar is set to host the FIFA World Cup in 2022, which has spurred a massive influx of labor migrants for various construction projects.
 
• These projects include the construction of stadiums, hotels, and other infrastructure necessary for the event.
 
• The preparation for this event has significantly impacted the country's population demographics.
